integrity: All claims supported by analytic mixed-section integration and explicit coefficient comparison; finite checker independent of proof. Originality comparison covers an intersecting planar case already present in earlier work and makes no novelty claim there.
scientific_limitations: Applies to all full-dimensional centrally symmetric convex bases in dimension d-1 with d at least three, centered homothetic top and bottom sections. No formula claimed for arbitrary asymmetric bases or skew nonhomothetic prismatoids. Historical priority is provisional; no universal inequality or global stability result claimed.
title: Exact reflected mixed volumes of homothetic frusta with symmetric bases
